revision_summary: No fabricated quotes found (deterministic check returned zero failures and manual spot-check confirms all quotes are accurately placed). However, several schema_reference citations are mismatched and should be corrected on rerun: (1) cherry_pick_moments[0]/[1] cite 'context.lead_types_and_bill_collection_rules' for the manufactured-home hold-and-check — this should instead cite 'dq_rules', since lead-type/bill-collection rules are unrelated to property-type disqualification. (2) cherry_pick_moments[3] cites 'button_up.is_that_fair_handshake' for the missing DQ-close warmth — this schema section only applies to booked appointments; since the schema has no defined DQ-close protocol, this should be flagged as a schema gap rather than misattributed to a booking-specific field. (3) cherry_pick_moments[6] cites 'cross_sell_signals.roof_replacement_planned' for the six-car-garage observation — the customer never mentioned a roof replacement, so this citation is unsupported; either drop the schema reference or explicitly label the garage observation as an unscripted, schema-adjacent hunch rather than tying it to an existing trigger. Additionally, collapse or relabel cherry_pick_moments[4] and [5] (both tagged 'curiosity_creation_failure') — they duplicate ground already covered correctly by interest_reason_audit and bill_anchor_audit and misuse the curiosity_over_features concept, which is specifically about the rep over-explaining solar to the customer, not about failing to re-anchor interest or reflect back a low bill figure. On rerun, also add a cherry_pick_moment for the 00:51–00:54 vulnerability disclosure ('I don't file taxes. I'm retired.') under coaching_philosophy.empathy_on_vulnerability_disclosure (fixed_income/retirement trigger) — this is a cleaner, earlier example of the empathy gap than the end-of-call DQ delivery Stage 3 chose to emphasize, and deserves its own entry rather than being folded only into state_changes. Finally, soften or support the trajectory_verdict.shape label 'energy_leaked' — the transcript shows a flat, polite ending rather than clear energy decline; either add textual support for the label or choose a more precise shape descriptor (e.g., 'abrupt_but_neutral_close').
